name: Anathema
source:
This is a short fangame of Identity V - dedicated to the ship Helel (Morningstar - Ithaqua) x Nebuchadnezzar (The Captive). It's inspired by The 2nd Essence of Season 25. Most of the events in the game is personal interpretations and headcanons.

[From [url=https://mwi7976.itch.io/anathema]Itch.io[/url]]
